causeOfInsufficientEvidence: The wrapper retained successful CPU image checks and scan results only at the end of verify(); a later command error prevented those intermediate facts from being saved.
safeResolution: Persist each verification substep and successful result immediately. Save only fixed credential filenames and bounded scanner rule/path/line/file SHA metadata, never findings' Match, Secret, raw lines or command stderr. Reject malformed reports and remove stale verification verdicts at start.
nextAttemptPurpose: Reproduce only the existing image and diagnose the evidenced verification failure with intermediate checkpoints; the completed hosted runner's unpublished image cannot be reused after teardown. No runtime change or dependency lowering.
